title: Color-indexed sections
summary: Each section gets its own color as wayfinding, either a chip next to the section number or a full-bleed band, so color tells you where you are.
use_when: Long single pages with distinct chapters.
avoid_when: Short pages; with fewer than 4 sections it just looks random.
